purpose: First bio-lab deployment smoke of v1.0.3 (commit d674472): validates salmon orchestration end-to-end on a real deep-library paired sample and the structural parity of the emitted quant.sf against the legacy pipeline's output. Single-sample commissioning run, not the batch benchmark.

methodology.warmup: none; cold cache first run on this host
methodology.disclosure: single cold-cache commissioning run; do not compare against warm-cache repeats
